citations.assessment: The opening verb describes Eifa’s recitation. The meeting with his brother follows in the same passage.
The pointer is to another notice about reciting Shevuot at Rabbah’s academy.
Avimi is explicitly called the brother of Eifa in the digital spelling.
Rashi supplies the father and locality of the two named brothers.
The dossier compares and distinguishes the reported spellings and contexts.
Avimi is called brother of Chifa, who tests him on the two teachings.
